matches.rationale: Findings 6, 4 and 1 together trace the paper's root mistake of conflating the observer's and the galaxy's reference frames: finding 6 shows the spurious metric-evolution term the paper uses to argue galaxies are in a different frame, finding 4 shows the undocumented frame-change inserted between eq.(26) and eq.(28), and finding 1 shows the resulting Etherington-relation failure that propagates from this frame mixing. These jointly match the GT's description of a pervasive reference-frame error underlying the paper's flawed equations.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Shows the downstream consequence (Etherington relation violated) of the reference-frame conflation introduced via eq.(28).
Identifies a real but unrelated algebraic slip (dropped division by 5 in eq.45) not covered by the reference-frame ground truth.
Correctly flags a Doppler-factor inconsistency in eq.(4) vs eq.(5), a separate defect not described by GT1.
Directly identifies the undocumented frame change between eq.(26) and eq.(28), the mechanism GT1 describes.
Points to a transcription mismatch between eq.(34) and eq.(36), unrelated to the reference-frame issue.
Exposes the spurious covariant-derivative term the paper uses to justify treating galaxies as being in a changing/different frame, matching GT1's mechanism.
Raises a genuine physical inconsistency (solid-angle conservation) in the CMB section, distinct from the reference-frame mechanism in GT1.
Flags a definitional typo (I_G vs F_G) unrelated to the reference-frame defect described in GT1.
